goal: Report outdated dependencies and propose safe patch and minor version bumps
rules: Report only: do not edit package.json, lockfiles, or any project file (L1)
List each outdated dependency with current version, latest safe version, and the changelog link
Flag any bump that is a major version separately with a one-line risk note
Verify the proposed set resolves together (no peer dependency conflicts) before proposing it
Group the proposal as one copy-paste command the user can run themselves
